Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time today — the discovery call was really helpful for understanding GreenGrid's latency targets and the requirement to keep embeddings in-region. A quick recap and a proposed next step:

Recap (short):
- Primary goal: get a production-grade inference setup for search/retrieval with strict data residency and audit logging.
- Key constraint: must support hybrid private deployment for sensitive PII workloads and hosted for lower-sensitivity services.
- Success metrics: 99th percentile latency < 120ms for 2k qps test, and cost per query under target once batching is applied.

Proposed next step: a 75–90 minute technical deep-dive where our ML/infra and ops leads walk through:
1) Current GreenGrid architecture & data flow (you)
2) Redwood serving runtime & integration touchpoints (Laura)
3) Quantization/throughput options & cost tradeoffs (Grace)
4) Security/compliance: VPC, KMS/HSM, audit logs (Grace)
5) Runbook for a pilot and acceptance criteria

Can you confirm which of these windows works for your team (we'll lock one):
- Tue Aug 10, 10:00–11:15 PT (75 min)
- Wed Aug 11, 13:00–14:30 PT (90 min)
- Thu Aug 12, 08:30–09:45 PT (75 min)

Please also confirm the attendee list (roles) we'd expect from GreenGrid so we can tailor the agenda. Attaching our discovery notes and a short prep checklist.

Attachments: (attachment: GGA-discovery-notes.pdf)
